                                     ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COENCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is amended by changing all the B3-3 Community Shopping District and RMS Residential
Multi-Unit District and symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 12-E in the area
bounded by:

   East 47th Street;
   the alley next east of and parallel to South Michigan Avenue;
   a line 60.15 feet south of and parallel to East 47*'' Street; and
   South Michigan Avenue;

to those of B3-3 Community Shopping District, which is hereby established in the area
above described.


SECTION 2: This ordinance shall take effect upon its passage and due publication.
